title: Add skeleton tool guidance to technique prompts
description: skeleton_compare, skeleton_sensitivity, and reference_scaffold tools are registered but the agent is never told about them. The technique prompts in mesh_context.py should reference these tools at appropriate workflow stages. Tool docstrings already explain HOW to use each tool — technique prompts only need to say WHEN.
definition-of-done: mesh_context.py technique prompts mention skeleton tools. coons_cage prompt recommends reference_scaffold for initial scaffolding. All technique prompts recommend skeleton_compare after plateauing. No docstring duplication between tool definitions and prompts.
testing-plan: Start a mesh-dsl session and verify skeleton tools appear in system prompt. Run a voyage batch and confirm agent calls skeleton tools when similarity plateaus.
